name: devops-on-aws-community-day
description: Beginner DevOps and Infrastructure as Code session with AWS CodePipeline

scripts.build:html: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && marp slides/deck.md --no-stdin --theme slides/theme.css --html --allow-local-files --output dist/slides.html
scripts.build:pdf: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && marp slides/deck.md --no-stdin --theme slides/theme.css --html --allow-local-files --pdf --output dist/devops-on-aws.pdf
scripts.build:pptx: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && marp slides/deck.md --no-stdin --theme slides/theme.css --html --allow-local-files --pptx --output dist/devops-on-aws.pptx
scripts.build: npm run qr && npm run build:html && npm run build:pdf && npm run build:pptx
